questions.prompt: You run the summarization prompt on a long ticket thread and the AI output says: 'Next step: escalate to the billing team and offer a partial refund.' The thread does not mention any partial refund discussion. What should you do?
choices: Follow the suggestion — AI is inferring from similar resolved tickets
Discard the summary entirely and read the thread manually
Keep the summary but remove the fabricated next step and check the thread for what the actual next step is
Add a note to the summary that the refund idea came from AI
questions.explanation: AI sometimes infers next steps that are not in the actual thread. The rest of the summary may be accurate. Remove the unsupported recommendation, check the thread for the real next step, and use the summary with that correction.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest use case for AI ticket summarization?
choices: Generating a summary to paste directly to the customer as a recap
Replacing the need to read the full thread before replying
Providing a structured handoff note when another agent takes over a ticket
Automatically closing tickets that have been inactive for seven days
questions.explanation: Handoffs are where AI summarization has the most impact — it replaces the need for an incoming agent to read an entire thread to understand where the ticket stands. Customer-facing summaries and fully automated responses both require careful human review.

questions.prompt: A ticket thread includes several screenshots of error messages that the customer attached. What does the AI summary contain about those screenshots?
choices: An accurate transcription of the text visible in each screenshot
A description of each image based on its filename
Nothing — or only a note that attachments are present — because AI cannot read image content from a pasted thread
A generated description based on what error messages typically contain
questions.explanation: AI summarizes what it can read. Image attachments in a ticket thread are not readable from pasted text, so the summary will either skip them or note their presence. Error message text from screenshots must be reviewed manually.
